comments.author: oldgradstudent
comments.story: A Waymo One Rider’s Experiences Highlight Autonomous Rideshare’s Shortcomings
comments.text: It may not have been easy to see that another breakthrough is required, but it was very easy to see that most predictions were laughable. The CEO of Waymo announced[1] in May 2018: > Phoenix will be the first stop for Waymo's driverless transportation service, which is launching later this year. Soon, everyone will be able to call Waymo, using our app, and a fully self-driving car will pull up--with no one in the driver's seat-- to whisk them away to their destination. And that's just the beginning! [1] [VIDEO]
